title: Exploring Fairness Interventions in Open Source Projects

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not directly measure specific biases in a model, but rather surveys, analyzes, and categorizes 62 open-source machine learning fairness interventions and tools (e.g., AIF360, Fairlearn) that detect and mitigate general algorithmic and demographic biases using metrics like Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, and Disparate Impact.
